create_interactivedocument: create an InteractiveDocument instance with a language model and optional random number generator
test_open_question: test asking an open-ended question to the model with an answer prefix and max tokens
test_open_question_forced: test asking an open question with a forced response instead of model sampling
test_open_question_diversified: test asking a diversified question that samples multiple answers and picks one randomly
test_multiple_choice_question: test asking a multiple choice question with shuffled answers and model selection
